description: This Java source file contains JUnit 5 (JUnit Jupiter) test cases for the ObsBehavior class in the OpenMRS project. It tests behaviors related to observations (Obs) and encounters within the clinical system, including loading, verifying dirty states, and voiding/replacing observations.

classes.name: ObsBehaviorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that performs end-to-end testing of observation and encounter behaviors such as loading, dirty state checks, and voiding/replacing Obs in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: shouldHaveAnObsLoadedFromTheDatabaseAsNotDirty
methods.description: Test method that verifies an Obs object loaded from the database is not marked as dirty.

methods.name: shouldHaveAllObsLoadedWithAnEncounterFromTheDatabaseNotMarkedAsDirty
methods.description: Test method that verifies all Obs associated with a loaded Encounter are not marked as dirty.

methods.name: shouldVoidAndReplaceOnlyEditedUnvoidedObsWhenTheyAreFlushedToTheDatabase
methods.description: Disabled test method that checks that only unvoided and edited Obs are voided and replaced upon saving an Encounter, ensuring correct Voiding behavior.
